reception: Beyond that follow-on, the external record is slender and mostly taxonomic. Surveys of FPGA programming abstractions and of high-level synthesis tools and toolchains place FROST among DSL-to-FPGA backends, and papers such as iPIM and work on transformations of high-level synthesis codes cite it as one instance of the DSL-to-HLS route. A few applied efforts in hardware-accelerated image and signal processing cite its speedups as evidence that FPGA acceleration pays. There is little building on the system outside its authors' orbit; in the literature the paper stands as a catalogued point in the design space of FPGA toolchains. The compiler lives on in the Tiramisu-Compiler/tiramisu repository.
